{{Top|leg}}
'''"Bordok feathers"''' was an [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] phrase that was used to express contempt for a foolish thought or idea, perhaps implying that it was as nonsensical as a [[Bordok/Legends|bordok]] having feathers.
